summary: Iteration 5 e2e test of the PER-MODULE Monitoring/SQ3R restructure. Backend: 37 pytest tests PASSED (auth incl. bcrypt $2b$ hash, httpOnly cookie on login, 5-fail lockout->429, counter reset, CORS credentials, worksheet CRUD + isolation + malformed-id 404, cookie-cannot-shadow-Bearer/escalate, admin stats/search, profile CRUD + embedded profile) plus a NEW test_per_module_monitoring_and_sq3r_round_trip verifying target_mingguan[].rows[] with nested monitoring{enabled,halaman_target/realisasi,waktu_target/realisasi,media,ketercapaian,penyebab,solusi} and sq3r{enabled,survey(judul_kegiatan[]),questions[],read,recite[],review{terjawab,dipahami,belum_dipahami}} round-trip VERBATIM through PUT+GET (row dict equality). Frontend (real public URL): student 0666652216 login -> dashboard -> create-worksheet-button -> editor with sections 3/4/5/6. Section 4 header is 'Minggu Ke- | Target Belajar | Jml Halaman Modul | Media Belajar | Lama Belajar (Jam) | Monitoring & SQ3R'; pl-mk-0 populated from profile ('Sistem Operasi (3)'); row0 cells filled; pl-0-addrow and pl-add-block work. monitor-btn-0-0 opens row-dialog titled 'Monitoring Belajar - Sistem Operasi (3) . Minggu 1'; salin-rencana-button correctly copied halaman 34 -> mo-halt, jam 3 -> mo-wt, media 'Modul, Google' -> mo-media (also verified on row 1: 20/2/BMP); mo-tercapai radix Select works (Ya/Tidak); dialog-done-button closes and monitor/sq3r buttons render a check and stay enabled. SQ3R dialog fields (sv-judul, sv-judulmodul, q-item-0, read-notes, recite-item-0, rv-belum-0) all fill. Section 5: progress-panel + progress-ring-0 = '100% / 1/1 minggu' with 1 Ya; after adding a 2nd module row with Ketercapaian=Tidak the ring recomputed to '50% / 1/2 minggu' and results-list showed 2 module cards with the full monitoring + SQ3R summary. Explicit save-button -> PUT 200 -> reload: mata kuliah, both planning rows, both monitoring dialogs (reopened: 34/34/3/3/Modul, Google/Ya/penyebab), the SQ3R dialog values, the checks, results-list (2 cards) and the 50% ring ALL persisted. dialog-clear-button ('Hapus Data') on row1 monitoring removed its check, dropped its results card and recomputed the ring to 100% 1/1, and that persisted after save+reload. Preview (worksheet-view) rendered sections 1 identitas, 2 tujuan/target/MK from profile, 3 jadwal semester + catatan, 4 planning table, 5 'Hasil Monitoring & SQ3R' with Progres ring (data-testid present in the view now), grouped Target/Realisasi monitoring table and the full SQ3R detail, 6 Peta Konsep, and download-pdf-button. Dashboard: stat-jam=5 (3+2), stat-progress=50%, reminder-card with reminder-day-1 (Senin) and reminder-day-3 (Rabu) from the Catatan text and correct 'no schedule today (Kamis)' message. Regression: profile save+persist (p-alamat), worksheet delete via confirm-delete-button (card removed, stat-progress back to 0%), logout -> /login, admin login -> /admin with stats+chart+search by NIM/title, admin-view of a student worksheet containing per-module monitoring/SQ3R rendered profile + all sections + 100% ring, RBAC both directions (student->/admin redirected to /dashboard, admin->/dashboard redirected to /admin). Zero console errors across all runs. ONE real defect found: the 1.5s autosave debounce is dropped on unmount, so an edit followed by an immediate navigation (typed peta-konsep then clicked Pratinjau) is silently lost.

minor.issue: data remains an untyped dict - nested monitoring/sq3r are stored with no schema validation (pre-existing design choice, round-trips fine).
CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True; Starlette echoes the origin so the test passes, but an explicit origin list is still safer.

ui_bugs.issue: DATA LOSS WINDOW: autosave fires 1500ms after the last change and the timer is cleared on unmount, so typing into a field and immediately clicking Pratinjau / Kembali ke Dashboard loses the edit with no warning (reproduced: typed 'PETA TES NAVIGASI' into peta-konsep, clicked preview-button -> value absent in preview and empty on returning to the editor). Flush the pending save on unmount/route change (or block navigation while dirty).

issues: dialog-done-button toasts 'Tersimpan' although it only closes the dialog - nothing is persisted until autosave/Simpan runs. Wording like 'Selesai' / 'Tersimpan sementara' would avoid a false sense of persistence, especially given the autosave-on-unmount loss above.
The grouped header's second row renders empty cells under Media/Ketercapaian/Penyebab/Solusi (no rowSpan), which reads as an extra blank header row in the PDF.

action_items: Flush the debounced save when WorksheetEditor unmounts (or before navigating to /view) so edits made <1.5s before navigation are not silently lost.
Optional: change the dialog 'Tersimpan' toast wording since the dialog does not persist to the server.
Optional: add rowSpan to the non-grouped monitoring columns in WorksheetView so the PDF header has no blank second row.
critical_code_review_comments: WorksheetEditor.js useEffect autosave: the cleanup clearTimeout on unmount discards a pending PUT -> silent data loss; call doSave on unmount when dirty.

openDialog() sets monitoring/sq3r.enabled=true on mere click, so an accidental click permanently adds a blank module card to Section 5 and the PDF until the user presses 'Hapus Data' (documented as by design, but consider enabling only when a field is filled).
computeCourseProgress ignores blocks with a blank mata_kuliah, so monitoring filled before selecting a course silently contributes 0 to the ring/stat-progress with no user hint.
parseDays does substring matching on the whole Catatan text; a word containing a day substring creates a false reminder - use word-boundary regex.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all per-module Monitoring/SQ3R, progress math, persistence, preview, admin/RBAC flows pass; 1 autosave data-loss defect)

rca_of_the_issue: Autosave data loss: WorksheetEditor stores the debounced save in saveTimer and the effect cleanup clears it; unmounting (SPA navigation to /view or /dashboard) runs the cleanup before the 1500ms elapses, so the last change is never PUT. Reproduction: open an editor, type into peta-konsep, click preview-button within ~1s -> value missing in the preview and gone when returning. Mitigation: on unmount (or in the preview/back handlers) await doSave(true) when dirty, or persist dirty state so navigation is blocked/queued.
